title: The lane lint runs the mutation anchor pre-check, so a stale or ambiguous anchor fails before CI
why: On #1820 a mutant's anchor matched twice in hooks/guard_core.py, and it passed both review and `merge --lane-lint`; only the full mutation run catches it, so CI would turn red (lane draft-pr-guard-heredoc, session_013NEJKzzx35nAWSwPacHRXt, 04:15 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: `merge --lane-lint` runs mutate_guard.py's stale and ambiguous anchor pre-check on its own; it is cheap and runs no mutants. Red case first: a lane whose mutant anchor matches twice passes the lane lint today; control: a lane with unique anchors passes as today. Topic: lane checks. Related steps lane-lint-hook-suites and lane-lint-runs-local-tools. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 04:13 CST Nov 8. Doing (lane draft-pr-guard-heredoc, 04:21 CST Nov 8): branch lane-lint-mutant-anchors from #1820's head e7c7e4461, Merge after: #1820.
